The Chinese characters for Carl

As a transliteration, Carl is usually written 卡尔 (Kǎ ěr). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

Carl comes from Germanic and means “free man (form of Charles)”.

About the name Carl

A solid Germanic name shared by the astronomer Carl Sagan.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “free man (form of Charles)”, a Carl calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
